title: CustomToolRequest
description: The request to interrogate one user-provided executable.

kind.description:
Executable family, keyed by the engine encoder: `aom`, `svt-av1`, `rav1e`, `vpx`,
`avm`, `x264`, `x265`, `vvenc`, or `ffmpeg` for muxing.

path.description: Absolute path to the executable the user selected.
